summary: Run the vitest suite against a throwaway home and SWITCHBOARD_DATA_DIR under the OS temp folder, so tests stop writing logs, databases, shell and worktree files into the developer's real ~/.switchboard.

desktop.reason: Electron resolves userData through app.getPath and never reaches the changed branch. The one src/main edit (runtime.ts userDataDir) throws only when VITEST is set and SWITCHBOARD_DATA_DIR is not, which no packaged or dev app run does.

reactNativeIos.reason: apps/mobile is untouched. Its jest suite imports only @shared modules and writes no files, so it never touched the home folder.

nativeAndroid.reason: apps/android is untouched. Its JVM tests create files only through Files.createTempDirectory, createTempFile and kotlin createTempDirectory, which live under java.io.tmpdir.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No wire protocol, IPC channel, event shape or handler changes. src/shared is untouched, and the headless server still falls back to ~/.switchboard when SWITCHBOARD_DATA_DIR is unset outside vitest.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, migration or persisted-state change. Only where the test run puts its throwaway database moved, and existing files in ~/.switchboard are left in place.

updateRelease.reason: Test configuration only (vitest.config.ts, tests/setup). No packaging, update channel, signing or release workflow changes.

automated: tests/unit/private-test-home.test.ts asserts os.homedir() and userDataDir() resolve inside the run root, that a real log line lands in the run root and not in the real ~/.switchboard/logs, that userDataDir() refuses the home fallback under vitest, and covers the guarded-removal and leak-matching rules.

The vitest global teardown fails the run if any log file named after one of the run's worker pids and written after the run started appears in the real ~/.switchboard/logs; a forced teardown throw was checked to exit vitest with code 1.
Full suite run: the real ~/.switchboard/logs file count and shell/.zshrc mtime were unchanged before and after.
notExercised: The Windows CI runner: USERPROFILE is redirected alongside HOME, but the suite was only run locally on macOS.
